repos_data.description: High-performance configuration management framework for Go applications with zero-allocation performance, universal format support (JSON, YAML, TOML, HCL, INI, Properties), and an ultra-fast CLI powered by Orpheus.

FlashFlags is an ultra-fast, zero-dependency, lock-free command-line flag parsing library for Go. Originally built for Argus, it provides great performance while maintaining simplicity and ease of use.
A CLI tool for managing and executing SQL queries across multiple databases. Written in Go, made beautiful with BubbleTea
A Commander for modern Go CLI interactions
goscaf generates opinionated, production-quality Go project boilerplate via an interactive CLI. Stop copy-pasting skeleton code between projects.

Go-Arch - a framework for scaffolding and evolving Go projects: CLI, installable template packs, executable generators, lifecycle hooks, and multi-project workspaces. Minimalist, Standard, and Hexagonal architectures.
Opinionated declarative CLI args, ENV vars and config files
Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and VPS.

✨ A complete and self-contained solution for developers of any qualification to create a production-ready project with backend (Go), frontend (JavaScript, TypeScript) and deploy automation (Ansible, Docker) by running only one CLI command.

Lightweight, type-safe database query builder for Go with zero production dependencies. Advanced SQL features (JOINs, subqueries, CTEs, window functions), batch operations (3x faster), LRU statement cache (<60ns).   Professional API documentation. PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite support.
A Go library for implementing command-line interfaces.
High performance and extensible micro web framework. Zero memory allocations in hot paths.

repo_meta_data.description: Orpheus is a high-performance CLI framework designed to be super simple and ~30× faster than popular alternatives with zero external dependencies. Built on FlashFlags, Orpheus provides a simple interface to create modern, fast CLI apps similar to git.
